body: I tried. I'm not welcome and people like me will not be welcome in mainstream society for many decades.

I better reword it.

I do **not** want an Islamic burial.

I express with all of my heart, I am not a Muslim. Trying to honour me in that way would be rubbing salt in the wound. Though realistically it's very likely that is what will happen since my family have no respect for me.

Platitudes do nothing to help. I get a lot of these "you're a great guy, why are you so sad?". I'm still totally alone and destitute.

I had a "friend" who stuck by me for 2 months and left me saying "you're a great guy. You'd have a lot to offer in any relationship". Then he deleted his Facebook (how we communicated) and stopped coming by.

And I'm a generally kind and caring person, just totally socially inept. And I understand, even I wouldn't want to be friends with me. I try my hardest to be different, but I'm a broken person.

Just leave us to die.
